segments.text: Phil has reconnected with Denise, an old high school girlfriend, on Facebook. He plans to meet her for a drink, and Claire immediately thinks that’s a terrible idea.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Manny is upset because he didn’t get the part he wanted in a school play. Jay tries to cheer him up with a motivational poster and hangs it above Manny’s pet turtle, Shel. The poster falls and kills the turtle.
